title: Full gate's temp guard failed again on __PSScriptPolicyTest_* probe files in the test run root, after the Engram fixture children were redirected; a PowerShell child outside those launch paths is suspected
outcome: The gate's temp guard stays green because no test leaves PowerShell's startup policy probe files in the shared run root. Each test that launches a PowerShell child, wherever that child is terminated, gives it a TEMP that the test's own temp root removes. The guard is not widened and production launches are unchanged.
acceptance: Fail-first. On unmodified 38b659b, a deterministic witness shows that a test-launched PowerShell child gets the shared run-root TEMP: the terminal shell run through run_terminal_shell_command_with_timeout prints its $env:TEMP, which equals the test process's TEMP and lies outside the test's own temp root. The probe-window measurement (.tmp/diag-ps, hashes in the note) is cited for the leak mechanism. The failed run is kept and cited.

Every test-reachable PowerShell child that can be terminated during startup gets, under cfg(test) only, a TEMP and TMP inside its test's own temp root, which that root removes. That covers the terminal shell when its workdir lies in a test temp root, the Start-Process grandchildren through it, and the review_freeze deadline fixture. A note gives an inventory, at 38b659b, of every PowerShell/pwsh launch reachable from tests, each classified as redirected, normal-exit-only, or late-terminated. A test per launch path shows the child's TEMP is inside its test temp root. The launcher's temp guard is not widened, and production launches are unchanged.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree; its run directory and fingerprint are cited in a note.

completion.summary:
Test-launched PowerShell children no longer leave the __PSScriptPolicyTest_* startup probe in the shared test run root. The fix landed on master as a plain fast-forward to 0789c6cc022cb6c5e5d8319cefb217dded1b9c68 (tree 43376160), verified on origin.
- Diagnosis H2: Windows PowerShell writes the probe at every start, and a kill inside the roughly 75 ms window leaks it.
- Fix, cfg(test) only: the terminal shell and its children get TEMP/TMP in <test root>/child-temp, links are refused, and the review_freeze deadline fixture gets its own child-temp. Production and the temp guard are unchanged.
- Fail-first: through the gate's run-root wrapper, test-f306abb0 FAILED.
- Gate test-1b575c84 PASS (credited d4431623); review round 4 clean; evaluation b9bfe3da 3/3.
- Test-only: no install or restart. Follow-ups filed: w-771bedcfe208 and w-b45e809bb82b.
